Completed transfers under EO12817 cannot by themselves establish a whole-order end. No Treasury determination, exhaustion, or signing-date effective event is inferred. EO12724 section 6 revokes EO12722 only to the extent inconsistent and continues administrative acts under the new order. EO12771 expressly does not terminate the Iraq emergency. EO12817 creates specific transfer mechanisms. EO13303 section 2(a) removes the orders from selected property, with section 2(b) savings. EO13350 revokes EO12722 but preserves blocked-property prohibitions and accrued effects. These are distinct partial transitions and cannot be replaced by one July30,2004 first-end date.

Original section 4(b) says the Commission shall terminate not later than September 30, 1992. EO12815 replaces only the date with December 31, 1992. This is a termination limit, unlike a report deadline, but the retained not-later-than wording and EO12869 description of committees terminated or work completed do not uniquely establish the actual first cessation date. I decline to convert that limit into an exact historical event.
